clue.text: Bold as tot in the Guatemalan capital

parts.note: to tot up is to sum, so tot gives SUM

indicators.note: the capital, or first letter, of the word Guatemalan is taken

explanation.surface: A toddler is behaving brashly while visiting Guatemala City.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The Guatemalan capital' looks like a city, but it means only the capital letter of Guatemalan.
explanation.definitionFit: Being presumptuous or forward is a synonym for being bold in manner.

clue.text: Beg a copper to ring

parts.note: a copper is a penny coin, abbreviated P
a ring of bells is a peal

explanation.surface: Someone pleads with a policeman to telephone them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Copper' suggests a policeman but here is a penny coin, P; 'ring' is a peal of bells, not a phone call.
explanation.definitionFit: To make an earnest request is to beg, a close synonym.

clue.text: Refits quite possibly causing contention

indicators.note: says the letters of the word refits could well be arranged some other way

explanation.surface: Repairs to a ship are causing arguments among the crew.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Quite possibly' rearranges REFITS.
explanation.definitionFit: Conflict and bitter disagreement are what both words name, so they are synonyms.

clue.text: Sounds pleasing to all in bars

definitions.text: Sounds pleasing to all in bars

parts.words: Sounds pleasing to all in bars
parts.note: suggests songs enjoyed by drinkers in pubs, but bars are also the measures into which a score is divided

explanation.definitionFit: Melodious sound written out in measures called bars is the art of composition and song.

clue.text: Having no spare note is really of no significance

parts.note: spare in the sense of lean or slight means thin
G is one of the musical notes

explanation.surface: Lacking even one extra note on the scale hardly matters.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spare' looks like 'extra' but means thin, lean; G is a note of the scale. 'Having' and 'is really' are link words.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that amounts to zero is unimportant, so 'it's nothing' means it is of no importance.

clue.text: Entrance is round back or handy

indicators.note: the word for an entrance is placed round another piece, enclosing it

parts.note: an adit is the horizontal entrance to a mine

indicators.note: the word or is read backwards, running from back to front

explanation.surface: A doorway placed around the rear is a convenient arrangement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Back' turns OR into RO, and 'round' puts ADIT around it. ADIT is a mine entrance, a crossword regular.
explanation.definitionFit: Being skilful and dexterous with the hands is what both words describe, so they are synonyms.

clue.text: American politicians cared most-for a change!

indicators.note: invites the letters of cared most to be altered into a new order

explanation.surface: US politicians cared most, a cynic says, for once.
explanation.walkthrough: 'For a change' rearranges CARED MOST.
explanation.definitionFit: Members of one of the two main US parties are politicians from America, so this is an example.

clue.text: This man is an expert, but one may well see through him

definitions.text: This man is an expert, but one may well see through him

parts.words: This man is an expert, but one may well see through him
parts.note: seeing through someone usually means spotting a fraud, but here it means seeing better with lenses from an eye specialist

explanation.definitionFit: An eye professional who supplies spectacles helps clients see through glasses he provides.

clue.text: Just keep going when there's no more credit available?

definitions.text: Just keep going when there's no more credit available?

parts.words: Just keep going when there's no more credit available?
parts.note: an engine idling just keeps going; read literally, tick is credit and over means finished

explanation.definitionFit: An engine idling at low speed keeps running without doing work, the phrasal verb's sense.

clue.text: The ruination of parties, a hanger-on can be

indicators.note: wrecking the word parties along with a means scrambling those letters

explanation.surface: A freeloader can ruin any party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ruination of' rearranges PARTIES with A.
explanation.definitionFit: A sponger who lives off others is a hanger-on, a figurative synonym.

clue.text: This is sickening stuff!

parts.note: sounds like a complaint about something disgusting, but it literally describes a substance that makes you vomit

explanation.definitionFit: A drug that induces vomiting literally makes a patient sick.

clue.text: Not now in circulation, certainly

indicators.note: the letters sit inside the run of words circulation, certainly

explanation.surface: A coin that is certainly no longer in circulation.
explanation.walkthrough: The run is in circulatiON CErtainly.
explanation.definitionFit: Formerly, at some past time, is the sense: not at present.

clue.text: A liking for disorder

definitions.meaning: a fondness or warm feeling for someone
an old medical sense, a disease or ailment of the body

explanation.definitionFit: Fondness is the everyday sense; in older medical usage the word also named an ailment or disease.

clue.text: Natural growth accountants love

parts.note: CA is a chartered accountant, so two of them give CA twice
love is zero in tennis, shaped like O

explanation.surface: Accountants adore organic produce.
explanation.walkthrough: CA stands for chartered accountant; the plural gives two. Love is O, the nil score in tennis.
explanation.definitionFit: The tree whose seeds give cocoa is a plant, so a natural growth.

clue.text: Paving for 30 across

definitions.meaning: a flat paving stone laid in a path
a banner or ensign carried on a pole

explanation.definitionFit: A flagstone is used for paving, and a banner flown on a pole is also called a standard.

clue.text: His plight could act as a warning to people in the main

definitions.text: a warning to people in the main

indicators.note: says the letters of his plight could form something else when rearranged

explanation.surface: A man's misfortune might serve as a cautionary tale to the public.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Could' rearranges HIS PLIGHT. 'In the main' means at sea (the main is the ocean), not 'mostly'; 'act as' links.
explanation.definitionFit: A vessel moored with a beacon warns sailors on the open sea of danger.

clue.text: Rise in the morning early, like the man at everyone's beck and call

indicators.note: the letters lie inside the run the man at everyone's

explanation.surface: Get up at dawn, like a servant at everyone's beck and call.
explanation.walkthrough: The run is thE MAN AT Everyone's; the rest is surface dressing.
explanation.definitionFit: To issue or arise from a source is the sense, as a smell comes forth.

clue.text: As the sun rises set about savoury food

indicators.note: the word rises is placed about, around, the word for sun

parts.note: taken as written
Sol is the Latin name for the sun

explanation.surface: At sunrise, someone starts cooking breakfast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Set' and 'rises' look like the sun's movements, but 'set about' puts RISES around SOL.
explanation.definitionFit: Fried cakes of minced meat are a savoury dish, an example of the food.

clue.text: Rebel leader interrupting to say repeatedly "Show-off!"

indicators.note: one piece breaks into the middle of the word for stammering

parts.note: to stutter is to repeat sounds when speaking

indicators.note: the leader of the word rebel is its first letter

explanation.surface: An insurgent chief keeps cutting in to call someone a braggart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rebel leader' looks like a person but is just R.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who swaggers about pompously is showing off, so a synonym.

clue.text: The whole thing is green-it's revolting

indicators.note: rising up or turning over, so the letters of green and it are overturned into a new order

parts.note: it is, giving just the letters of it

explanation.surface: An environmentally friendly product is disgusting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Revolting' looks like 'disgusting' but rearranges GREEN and IT.
explanation.definitionFit: A whole number, with no fraction, is the mathematical sense of 'the whole thing'.

clue.text: The girl stood up

definitions.meaning: got to one's feet, past tense of rise

explanation.definitionFit: A girl's name and the past tense of rise, meaning got up.

clue.text: Worthless support

definitions.meaning: the bottom part something rests on

explanation.definitionFit: Base means low or ignoble in one sense, and a foundation that holds something up in another.

clue.text: Sound lad, a hard worker and resilient

indicators.note: the word for lad is said out loud, giving a word that sounds the same

parts.note: a lad is a boy
the ant is proverbially industrious

explanation.surface: A healthy boy who works hard and bounces back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sound' looks like 'healthy' but signals a soundalike: BOY spoken gives BUOY.
explanation.definitionFit: Able to float, and figuratively cheerful and quick to recover, which is resilience.

clue.text: The queen's place in Canada

definitions.meaning: Latin for a queen, as in royal titles

explanation.definitionFit: Latin for a reigning queen, and also the name of the capital city of Saskatchewan province.

clue.text: A dispatch about a number getting rise

indicators.note: the word for dispatch goes about, around, a number

parts.note: to dispatch something is to send it
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred

explanation.surface: A message about a figure going up.
explanation.walkthrough: C is the Roman numeral 100.
explanation.definitionFit: To go up or climb is to rise, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Check a cask that's in the way

indicators.note: the cask word goes inside the abbreviation for street

parts.note: ST is street, a way
a tun is a large barrel

explanation.surface: Inspect a barrel that is blocking the road.
explanation.walkthrough: A TUN is a large barrel.
explanation.definitionFit: To hinder or restrict growth is to check it, so a synonym.

clue.text: A good man put down for giving the very latest news

parts.note: a saint, abbreviated ST
to put down a people is to oppress them

explanation.surface: A decent fellow is suppressed for reporting breaking news.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A good man' is a crossword standby for ST, saint.
explanation.definitionFit: A late item inserted in a newspaper after printing began gives readers the freshest report.

clue.text: Left in great discomfort, that's clear

indicators.note: the letter goes inside the word for discomfort

parts.note: pain is severe discomfort

explanation.surface: Abandoned in agony, that much is obvious.
explanation.definitionFit: Obvious or evident is the shared sense, making them synonyms.

clue.text: Some fruit brightened up a Greek character

parts.note: lit up means brightened
chi is a letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: Fruit cheered up a Greek person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Character' looks like a person but is a letter, CHI.
explanation.definitionFit: The lychee, a Chinese fruit, is an example of fruit.

clue.text: Potentially explosive reading matter?

parts.note: suggests a scandalous periodical, but the word also names a store for ammunition

explanation.definitionFit: A periodical is reading matter, and an arms store or gun chamber holds explosives.

clue.text: Battles for what's left

explanation.definitionFit: Fights or brawls in one sense, and leftover bits of food in the plural.

clue.text: Dicky darts about with 14 across

indicators.note: the jumbled darts go about, around, the word for with
dicky means unsound or shaky, so the letters of darts are disordered

parts.note: with means along with, and

explanation.surface: Faulty darts flying around a banner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dicky' (British slang for shaky) rearranges DARTS into STARD; 'about' puts it round AND.
explanation.definitionFit: A banner or flag carried on a pole is the shared sense of these two entries.
